card.name: The word for after drug names
card.fires_on: The word "for" right after a drug name or dosage form, where it begins a product title like "for Injection" or "for inhalation".

modes.label: Drug name plus for Injection
modes.description: "for" follows a generic drug name or salt and starts the phrase "for injection".
modes.example: Caspofungin Acetate<< for>> Injection Ciprofloxacin Injection D

modes.label: Dosage form plus for
modes.description: "for" follows a form word such as solution or liquid and introduces a route or use.
modes.example: Ustekinumab-aekn solution<< for>> intravenous infusion must be diluted, prepared

card.writes: It seems to push toward route and dosage-form words after "for", though the listed output tokens look mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "for" in product names like "drug X for injection".
